matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Offense vs. Pass Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass offense grades 77/100 (above average) against MIA's pass defense at 3/100 (among the NFL's worst) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing about Miami's pass defense: a grade of 3 out of 100 isn't just bad, it's historically, catastrophically, almost scientifically bad — and our pass offense (77/100) happens to be the sharpest weapon we're bringing to Hard Rock Stadium. The math is genuinely lopsided: we should be able to move the ball through the air at will, which matters in an afternoon game where Miami's own offense (16/100 passing grade) isn't exactly going to keep us in a shoot-out. The real chess match is our run defense (55/100) against their rushing attack (90/100), so keeping their ground game honest will be crucial — but if we can establish some passing rhythm early, we're looking at the kind of one-sided matchup that doesn't come around very often. We're 2-3 in our last five against Miami, so there's no such thing as a guaranteed road win in this division, but the talent disparity on one side of the ball is just too stark to ignore.
